description: CENTRO DE REFERÊNCIA EM ÁREAS DE RISCO (CREAR) BELO HORIZONTE is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Localização de equipamento público de atendimento mais ágil e próximo às famílias que moram em áreas de risco e que necessitam de abrigamento emergencial no município de Belo Horizonte. Frequência de Atualização: DIÁRIA. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are centro, referencia, assistencia, social, habitacao. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
